name: AdaptCLIPZS Benchmark
description: A benchmark consisting of 14 datasets designed to evaluate zero-shot classification performance of vision-language models across fine-grained natural domains by leveraging category descriptions generated by large language models and fine-grained image classification datasets.
reputation: A recent research benchmark from the AdaptCLIP paper that is cited in the vision-language zero-shot evaluation literature, but it is not yet a widely standardized community benchmark.
notes: Includes 14 datasets; improves zero-shot classification by training with bag-level image-text supervision and LLM-generated category descriptions.
